page_summary: This page discusses the differences in reporting obligations and response mechanisms for cybersecurity incidents across various income groups. It highlights that 65% of respondents from high-income countries are required to notify a national or sectoral response body, while only 33% of respondents from low- and middle-income countries report a mandatory obligation. The findings indicate variations in institutional maturity and regulatory capacity, affecting information sharing and situational awareness.
